identity_rule: No regenerated coordinate or count identity claim until comparison with a recovered original manifest; that manifest is unavailable.

input_roles.campus-navigation.json: Blender Z-up road/path centers, widths, heights and water hazards. All route segments remain collision constraints, including excluded lighting seeds.
input_roles.world-config.js: Three XYZ final game boxes, oriented static colliders/doors, solid polygons and two main-building roads; convert [x,y,z] to Blender [x,-z,y].
input_roles.transit-config.js: Eight campus shuttle and two modeled city-stop waiting points. Metadata-only city stops excluded.
input_roles.evaluated_native_inventory: Exact visible native object names, collections and evaluated world bounds. Supplies trees, vehicles, small obstacles, outdoor parking seeds and garage envelope.
input_roles.campus.glb/building.glb: Original raw finite mesh support and existing lamp geometry; mmap and bounded numpy batches, never Python object per global triangle.

patches.geometry: Only actual source triangles clipped preserving original planes; no new floor or corridor widening.
patches.degeneracy: Discard exact zero-area output triangles only; preserve positive-area thin triangles and source provenance.

output_schema.manifest: contracts/street_lighting_manifest.json, schema_version=1, revision_id=street_lighting_v6, Blender Z-up metre coordinates
output_schema.power_semantics: Blender radiant-power visual parameter, not electrical consumption or measured illuminance.
output_schema.freeze: qa/placement_freeze.json hashes manifest, reports and scripts; manifest contains report paths only to avoid hash cycles.

verification: Finite raw triangle plane and edge error in physical metres, not unstable barycentric weights on needle triangles.
All eight footing ray provenances per fixture.
Existing lamp local bounds and clearance margin.
No poles inside expanded native garage footprint envelope.
Every modeled transit waiting point tested against actual clipped finite patch; nominal radius alone is insufficient.
Finite strict JSON, file hashes, RSS below 600 MiB.
